description: Proximity to road is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Transport", published or maintained by Offgrid Market Opportunities. Select areas that are within a particular distance from a major road. Coverage: Nigeria, Tanzania, Zambia. It has 4 files in GeoJSON. The portal files it under Energy access, Transport. The portal gives 2010 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
